headline: Shearwater wins CO2-storage seismic survey contract offshore Australia (Bonaparte Basin)
summary: Shearwater GeoServices was awarded a 3D seismic survey (vessel SW Bly, ~50 days, Q3 2026 start) to appraise carbon-storage potential in the Bonaparte Basin for INPEX's proposed CCS project; data will high-grade injection-well locations and serve as a 4D monitoring baseline. It is Shearwater's second Bonaparte CCS survey after 2024.
co2crc_note: Australian offshore storage characterisation and a 4D MMV baseline — squarely in CO2CRC's Otway monitoring wheelhouse.

headline: Northern Lights completes phase-1 LCO2 carrier fleet as 'Northern Purpose' arrives in Norway
summary: The fourth dedicated 7,500 m3 liquefied-CO2 carrier, Northern Purpose, arrived in Norway on 29 July after delivery from Dalian, completing the four-vessel fleet (Pioneer, Pathfinder, Phoenix, Purpose) for phase-1 CO2 shipping to the Oygarden receiving terminal and positioning the JV to scale customer operations.
co2crc_note: Benchmarks the cross-border LCO2 shipping-and-terminal logistics that underpin Australia's CO2-import storage ambitions (e.g. Moomba/Japan).

headline: Williams selects ExxonMobil for CO2 transport and storage from Louisiana Energy Gateway
summary: Williams selected ExxonMobil to transport and permanently store up to 1 Mtpa of CO2 captured from its proposed Louisiana Energy Gateway gas-fired power facility, extending ExxonMobil's Gulf Coast CCS customer portfolio into power generation. The project remains subject to FID, permitting and other approvals.
co2crc_note: Signals ExxonMobil's transport-and-storage-as-a-service model extending to gas-fired power — a commercial template for shared-hub operators.
